firmware.releaseNotes: Show verified phone-provided firmware offers on every stable device page, independently of battery or recording eligibility, while retaining explicit fresh consent and all installation safety checks. Device OTA now shows MCU-confirmed durable transfer progress and apply status using the existing SD-update styling; sent bytes and END ACK are not reported as upgrade success. Dismissing an offer preserves the current page, stale asynchronous offers are rejected, SD import blocks a competing update action, and accepting from LiveMap releases its shared workspace before BLE starts. Pair with original-signed App 1.0.87 for creation-only Android companion runtime bootstrap and sanitized background diagnostics after service recreation. Preserve existing protocol, BLE identity, keys, layout, Boot, package integrity, no-open-recording and battery-or-charging admission. Build and register original GCC full/recovery candidates only; channel publication and delta selection remain owner-controlled. Hardware verification requires installing this receiver before testing a higher target.
